verdict.rationale: The evidence documents an extensive Dynadot API with more than 120 actions, including registering domains. Nothing describes self-serve API key issuance or a sandbox or test environment where registrations cost no real money. Grace deletion for domain tasting is a related refund feature on live registrations, not an isolated test environment, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get API credentials self-serve and test safely — a sandbox or test environment where registrations don't cost real money
